sentences: A jar this large and round was too difficult to throw in one piece, so potters made the top and bottom halves separately, joined them, and fired them together.
The seam and slightly lopsided silhouette that result mean a moon jar shows a different face from every angle.
It has no decoration at all, and its white is not pure but a warm milky tone touched with grey.
Twentieth-century painters and art historians named it the moon jar for its resemblance to a full moon, and it became a symbol of Korean beauty.
What remains when ornament is stripped away is a generous calm, which is why Joseon porcelain is treasured in museums around the world.
